opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: One battery. Two pounds. And your clock is yours again.

opening.speaker: MS. ELLIS
opening.text: The other shop said I needed a new computer. This one has Arthur's letters on it.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: Then this is the right computer. I made you a second copy, too.

opening.speaker: MS. ELLIS
opening.text: Ninety-three years old, and I finally meet an honest repair man.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: Don't tell anyone. Terrible for business.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: I'll be right with you, Mr. Thomas.

opening.speaker: MS. ELLIS
opening.text: Give that cat a biscuit from me. And get some sleep, Steven.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: Yes, ma'am. See you next Thursday.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: You're wearing sunglasses in a computer shop, Oleg. I had to give you something ordinary.

opening.speaker: OLEG
opening.text: Tallinn. Meridian. An asset called the Widowmaker. Eight million pension records. An auction at midnight.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: Someone found a way to steal from people who can't fight back.

opening.speaker: OLEG
opening.text: Destroy the root signing key. The operation dies with it. First class. A service identity. And your usual tools.

opening.speaker: STEVE
opening.text: Good. The cat sitter charges by the hour.

arrival.speaker: OLEG
arrival.text: Your badge is for night maintenance. Enter through the loading bay.

arrival.speaker: OLEG
arrival.text: Security feed zero seven. Keep the watchdog powered. Seat the bridge on a green diagnostic pulse.

arrival.speaker: STEVE
arrival.text: Nobody reads the maintenance manual until something starts going bang.

arrival.speaker: OLEG
arrival.text: The chiller is down. Spare fuses are in the power room. Check the rating. I am not paying for a second Steve.

arrival.speaker: STEVE
arrival.text: Give me a meter and some quiet.

arrival.speaker: OLEG
arrival.text: Copy the archive before destroying the root key. Your encrypted drive is in the kit.

core.speaker: MERIDIAN
core.text: Unauthorized technician. Your warranty is void.

core.speaker: OLEG
core.text: There is your asset. Take the key down and leave.

core.speaker: STEVE
core.text: Those are people's lives. The backup is safe. Now we take the key down.

core.speaker: MERIDIAN
core.text: You cannot repair what you do not understand.

core.speaker: STEVE
core.text: I understand a dead battery when I see one.

ending.speaker: OLEG
ending.text: The auction is gone. Every account frozen. You were asked to destroy the key.

ending.speaker: STEVE
ending.text: I did. And sent the records to the people who can return the money.

ending.speaker: OLEG
ending.text: That was not in the brief.

ending.speaker: STEVE
ending.text: Neither was the part where Ms. Ellis was on page seven.

ending.speaker: MS. ELLIS
ending.text: Steven? It's me. My bank called. Something wonderful has happened.

ending.speaker: STEVE
ending.text: Glad to hear it, Ms. Ellis. Bring the computer in Thursday. We'll give it a clean.

camera_loop.speaker: OLEG
camera_loop.text: You have given security a recording of itself. Nice trick.

pump_online.speaker: STEVE
pump_online.text: Six point three amps. Protective equipment with an actual job.

cooling_ready.speaker: OLEG
cooling_ready.text: The thermal interlock is green. The archive is in the east office.

copy_ready.speaker: STEVE
copy_ready.text: There she is. Ms. Ellis, page seven. This one is coming with me.

key_down.speaker: MERIDIAN
key_down.text: Signing key invalid. Emergency security restored.

escape.speaker: OLEG
escape.text: Roof hatch. West maintenance bay. They know. Keep your light off.

wrong_fuse.speaker: STEVE
wrong_fuse.text: That rating is wrong. Protect the motor, not the inventory.

ellisbios.speaker: STEVE
ellisbios.text: Twenty twenty six. Not bad for something they wanted to throw away.
